$comment: Everything this account's Claude Code should have on any machine. Skills are delivered as marketplace plugins; the installer only handles what a marketplace cannot: system tools and API keys.

marketplaces.note: This repo, and the only marketplace needed. video-use and design-dna are vendored wrappers (their upstreams put SKILL.md at the repo root, which the plugin loader cannot see). gsap-skills and superseo are referenced upstream by URL, not copied -- both already use the canonical skills/<name>/ layout.
